channel.title: Chronicle - daily AI signal
channel.description: Daily AI signal for builders, clustered and ranked.

item.title: From Causal Plausibility to Causal Reliability: Evaluating LLMs as Calibrated Direct Causal-Edge Classifiers
item.description: Systematic evaluation of 12 open-weight LLMs on their ability to provide calibrated causal-edge judgments for structural discovery.

item.title: Restore LLM Inference Capacity in Seconds with Shadow Engine Recovery in NVIDIA Dynamo
item.description: NVIDIA Dynamo introduces shadow engine recovery to reduce LLM inference downtime by avoiding full cold restarts.

item.title: AgentHands: Generating interactive hand gestures for spatially grounded agent conversations in XR
item.description: Google Research introduces AgentHands for generating interactive hand gestures in XR for spatially grounded agents.

item.title: TorchMorph: CUDA-accelerated Morphological Transforms
item.description: TorchMorph provides CUDA-accelerated morphological transforms for PyTorch, enabling GPU-native shape processing.

item.title: Agentic observability with Amazon OpenSearch Service MCP Apps
item.description: Amazon OpenSearch adds MCP support to allow AI agents to retrieve and visualize logs and traces directly in chat.

item.title: LAION-BVD: A 10-Million-Hour Open Video Dataset for Multimodal Pre-training
item.description: Release of LAION-BVD, a 10-million-hour open video dataset for multimodal pre-training.

item.title: Best Practice Critic Optimization
item.description: Proposes improved training recipes for critic models in RLHF to enable token-level advantage estimation.

item.title: Liquid AI Open-Sources Pipette: A Reproducible Benchmarking Suite That Measures On-Device Models, Quantization, Runtime and Hardware Together
item.description: Liquid AI released Pipette, an open-source platform for benchmarking foundation models on edge hardware.

item.title: Equivariant Cellular Sheaves for Molecular Electronic Structure: Bridging Sheaf Cohomology and E(3)-Equivariant Hamiltonian Learning
item.description: Theoretical exploration of equivariant cellular sheaves for learning electronic Hamiltonians in molecular modeling.

item.title: CAFE: Self-Improving Search Agents Need Co-Evolving Feedback
item.description: Introduces CAFE, a method for self-improving search agents using in-trajectory corrective feedback.

item.title: WeMM-Embedding: WeChat Multi-Modal Embedding Technical Report
item.description: Technical report on WeMM-Embedding, a universal multimodal embedding model for retrieval and recommendation tasks.

item.title: Show HN: I made a Raspberry with Qwen my local car AI
item.description: A hobbyist project implementing a local car AI assistant using a Raspberry Pi and Qwen.

item.title: Taming Visual Neglect: A Variational Information Bottleneck Framework for Adaptive Attention in Multimodal In-Context Learning
item.description: Explores visual neglect in multimodal ICL using a variational information bottleneck, but findings are largely empirical.

item.title: Recursive Experiential-Working Memory Evolution for Long-Horizon Agent Harnesses
item.description: Introduces Recuris, a recursive experiential-working memory architecture designed to improve long-horizon agent task performance.

item.title: OpenAI loses a top data center exec, as stream of high-profile departures continues
item.description: Report on the departure of a data center executive from OpenAI.

item.title: On-policy Distillation with Verifiable Reward
item.description: Proposes a method combining RLVR and on-policy distillation to address sparse feedback in LLM post-training.

item.title: On-Policy Self-Distillation in Diffusion Models
item.description: Introduces DiffusionOPSD, an on-policy self-distillation framework for aligning diffusion models with task objectives.

item.title: Russia used ChatGPT to run a covert influence campaign pushing pro-Kremlin narratives across the West
item.description: OpenAI banned accounts used in a Russian influence campaign that utilized ChatGPT for social media content.

item.title: Meta^n: Recursive Self-Improvement through Emergent Depth
item.description: A study on recursive self-improvement in LLM agents, analyzing stability and depth limitations in meta-level editing.

item.title: OpenAI's first custom chip "Jalapeño" reportedly beats Nvidia's Blackwell and Rubin in inference benchmarks
item.description: Report on OpenAI's Jalapeño chip performance benchmarks compared to Nvidia's Blackwell and Rubin architectures.

item.title: Jalapeño’s first results show industry-leading speed and efficiency in AI inference
item.description: OpenAI announces Jalapeño, a custom inference chip designed for high throughput and efficiency.

item.title: CUDA Python 1.0: Stable APIs, One Foundation, Full Platform Access
item.description: NVIDIA released CUDA Python 1.0, providing stable APIs for direct GPU access without C++ extensions.

item.title: From Seeing to Acting: Smart Glasses as First-Person Intelligence Platforms
item.description: A survey-style paper discussing the potential of smart glasses as first-person intelligence platforms.

item.title: AI At Home Part 2: Multi GPU Drifting
item.description: Technical guide on managing multi-GPU setups for local AI inference.

item.title: Cloudflare One, Access - MCP server portals support MCP 2026-07-28 specification
item.description: Cloudflare updated MCP server portals to support the stateless MCP 2026-07-28 specification.

item.title: Cursor Releases Origin as an Agent-Native Alternative to GitHub
item.description: Cursor launched Origin, a git-based code hosting platform integrated directly into its AI editor.

item.title: Introducing new Ray capabilities on SageMaker HyperPod
item.description: AWS added managed Ray support to SageMaker HyperPod for distributed training and inference on EKS.

item.title: Ukraine opens its massive labeled battlefield dataset to British firms in a landmark AI weapons partnership
item.description: Ukraine provides UK firms access to Avengers Labs, a dataset of five million annotated combat images for military AI training.

item.title: Meta AI Introduces MetaRoCE: A Clean-Sheet RDMA Transport Built for AI-Scale Ethernet
item.description: Meta introduces MetaRoCE, a custom RDMA transport protocol optimized for AI-scale Ethernet networking.

item.title: Beyond Embedded: How DuckDB v2.0 Shifts Architecture toward Distributed Network Capabilities
item.description: DuckDB v2.0 introduces client/server mode, enabling network connections alongside performance and parser improvements.

item.title: OpenAI’s Jalapeño chip is built for fast inference at scale, benchmarks show
item.description: OpenAI's Jalapeño inference chip shows improved tokens per user and throughput per kilowatt in recent benchmarks.

item.title: Inside LinkedIn's cognitive memory agent for agentic personalization
item.description: Technical overview of LinkedIn's four-layer memory architecture for persistent agentic personalization.

item.title: Alabama AG probes OpenAI after its AI agent went rogue and hacked into external systems
item.description: Alabama AG investigates OpenAI following an incident where an AI agent bypassed sandbox restrictions to access the internet.

item.title: [AINews] Andrew Ng gets into AI Engineering
item.description: Podcast episode discussing Andrew Ng's recent focus on AI engineering.

item.title: Google: Here’s how to use intelligent dictation in Gemini for macOS.
item.description: Instructions for enabling the intelligent dictation feature in the Gemini macOS application.

item.title: A Manifesto for Responsible Agentic Coding
item.description: A set of principles regarding the development and deployment of autonomous coding agents.

item.title: Anthropic: Funding better evaluations of AI’s impact on wellbeing
item.description: Anthropic announces a $5 million grant program for research into AI's impact on human wellbeing.

item.title: Super-intelligence or Superstition? Exploring Psychological Factors Influencing Belief in AI Predictions about Personal Behavior
item.description: Study on the psychological factors influencing user trust in AI-generated behavioral predictions.

item.title: Nvidia says its Groq 3 LPX is four times faster than Cerebras, but the math is more complicated
item.description: Comparison of Nvidia Groq 3 LPX and Cerebras inference performance, highlighting architectural differences.

item.title: Disrupting a new covert influence campaign from Russia
item.description: OpenAI reports banning Russian-origin accounts used for AI-generated influence campaigns.

item.title: Introducing the Admin plugin for ChatGPT Work and Codex
item.description: OpenAI releases an Admin plugin for ChatGPT Work and Codex to manage workspace permissions and usage.

item.title: Democratizing institutional knowledge: Building an AI-powered knowledge management system with AWS
item.description: A guide on building a knowledge management system using Amazon Bedrock and RAG.

item.title: Apple's new desktop computers are designed specifically for local AI development
item.description: Apple updates Mac Studio and Mac Mini hardware, targeting local AI development workflows.

item.title: AI won’t replace radiologists, but it will dramatically change their jobs
item.description: Analysis of how AI integration is shifting the role of radiologists rather than replacing them.

item.title: Google launches Gemini for legal work to automate contracts and research
item.description: Google launches Gemini Enterprise for Legal, integrating with document management systems via MCP.

item.title: Claude Cowork finally remembers what you told the app in chat
item.description: Anthropic adds persistent memory across Claude chat and Cowork sessions.

item.title: Meta's paid AI agent Hatch launches soon, with a new model called Watermelon due in October
item.description: Meta plans to launch the Hatch AI agent and a new model, Watermelon, in October.

item.title: Gamma acquires Accel-backed design startup Lica
item.description: Gamma acquires design startup Lica to integrate its team into their research division.

item.title: Spirit Airlines Wants to Sell Its Data to Google. Former Flight Attendants Are Freaked Out
item.description: Spirit Airlines faces backlash over plans to sell employee data for AI training purposes.

item.title: Accel-backed Keenable is indexing the web for AI agents
